# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in this project.

## Security and compatibility

- New privileges, transports, dependencies, or data exposure:
- CLI/MCP compatibility impact:
- Rollback or recovery impact:

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `make quality`
- [ ] Independent code/security review completed
- [ ] Independent architecture review completed when boundaries changed
- [ ] Code-review-graph impact inspected and source-verified
- [ ] Tests protect behavior or risk; none exist only to inflate coverage
- [ ] File-size/complexity exceptions are justified and have a recovery task
- [ ] Platform-specific evidence is synthetic and sanitized
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when users are affected
- [ ] No credentials, private topology, real guest data, dumps, screenshots, or transcripts
